title: Numerical evaluation
statement: Given real coefficients $c(S)$ indexed by subsets $S$ of the $n$ coordinates, define the associated function on binary vectors by $x\mapsto\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}c(S)m_S(x)$, where $m_S$ is the numerical monomial that is $1$ exactly when every coordinate in $S$ equals $1$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Real coefficients indexed by subsets of the $n$ coordinates
